description: A partial recursive solution is a function on a downward-closed subset that satisfies the supplied rule at every point of its domain.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartialRecursiveSolution.{u, v} {α : Type u} {S : Type v} [LinearOrder α]
  (Φ : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.RecursionRule α S) : Type (max u v)
